Bash(docker exec -i ahpunjab-postgres psql -U ahpunjab -d ahpunjab_db -c "
WITH institute_info AS (
  SELECT institute_type FROM institutes WHERE institute_id = 1
),
institute_specific AS (
  SELECT
    target_type,
    vaccine_id,
    annual_target,
    monthly_target,
    ''specific'' as source
  FROM institute_targets
  WHERE institute_id = 1
    AND effective_from <= CURRENT_DATE
    AND (effective_until IS NULL OR effective_until >= CURRENT_DATE)
),
type_defaults AS (
  SELECT
    dt.target_type,
    dt.vaccine_id,
    dt.annual_target,
    dt.monthly_target,
    ''default'' as source
  FROM institute_type_default_targets dt
  JOIN institute_info ii ON dt.institute_type = ii.institute_type
  WHERE dt.effective_from <= CURRENT_DATE
    AND (dt.effective_until IS NULL OR dt.effective_until >= CURRENT_DATE)
)
SELECT DISTINCT ON (target_type, vaccine_id)
  target_type,
  vaccine_id,
  annual_target,
  monthly_target,
  source
FROM (
  SELECT * FROM institute_specific
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM type_defaults
) combined
ORDER BY target_type, vaccine_id, source DESC;
")
